title: National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic (NSP)
provider: SAIA, n.o. / Slovak Ministry of Education, Research, Development and Youth
description: Scholarships for international students, PhD candidates, university teachers and researchers to complete a study, research or teaching stay at a Slovak higher education institution or research organisation.
amount: EUR 620 per month (master's students) up to EUR 1,200 per month (researchers), plus possible travel allowance

title: Scholarships for Talented International Students
provider: Slovak Ministry of Education, Research, Development and Youth
field: Fields linked to the Smart Specialisation Strategy of the Slovak Republic
description: New scholarship scheme for talented international students starting full-time bachelor's or master's study at a Slovak higher education institution in priority fields.
amount: Up to EUR 15,000 in total, paid as EUR 500 per month over the first three years of a bachelor's (or first two years of a master's)

title: Comenius University Bratislava Institutional Scholarships
description: Merit and rector's scholarships and tuition reductions for international students at Slovakia's largest and oldest university.
amount: Partial tuition fee reduction and one-off merit awards (varies by faculty)

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Slovakia-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Slovak institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
